6.
(1) The Minister shall be responsible for the general
direction and administration of this Act.
(2) The Minister may from time to time issue to the Board
of Governors such written directions in regard to matters as
he may consider necessary. Every written direction issued
under  this  subsection  shall  be  tabled  in  Parliament  within
three months of the date of its issue.
